subject: [RFC PATCH v3 2/8] mm/gup: convert follow_page_mask() to return a long

2026-08-11.patch_summary: This patch changes the return type of follow_page_mask() and its helper functions from struct page pointer to long. The function now returns 0, a negative errno, or 1 with the page stored in a new pages[0] slot. This allows the return value to carry a page count rather than a single struct page pointer.
